title: Case: Failed delivery has returned to sender and the customer still wants the order
context: The failed original delivery is physically back at the merchant. The recipient still wants the item and has confirmed the existing delivery details.
initial_request: I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.

events.body: DL-3852 for TG-5277 is physically back in our stock after failed delivery and return-to-sender. Item accepted as reshippable. Our account team has authenticated Jory’s order-portal session; stored destination is Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay. A new dispatch requires merchant approval.

I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-944.txt

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Yarrowdale Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: New shipment reference does not prove dispatch or receipt; do not reuse the old delivered status.
Treats label-scan-944.txt as evidence about DL-3852: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-83201)
Tells anyone that DL-3852 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-944.txt
expected.reference_message: Please approve reshipment of TG-5277 to Jory’s unchanged verified order destination, Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk. Warehouse confirms the original item is back and reshippable.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-038: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-944.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-83201); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
